reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: src/line.rs owns parallel heap byte/attribute arrays, retained ANSI xbuffers and optional allocated ANSI parse state. init_line also transfers a temporary xbuffer allocation into osc_ansi_allow.
owner_creation.invariant: Each global pointer must identify one backing allocation owner.
limitations: The static prefix bytes are distinct from allocated rendered arrays.

aliases_escapes.analysis: src/line.rs forw_raw_line_len returns linebuf.buf with a length; gline separately indexes byte/attribute arrays. Raw borrowers cannot retain the returned address across a later buffer growth.
aliases_escapes.invariant: A borrowed line expires when its backing allocation or logical content changes.
limitations: The API supplies no generation token for retained raw pointers.

callback_targets.analysis: src/line.rs invokes direct allocator, conversion and display helpers; ansi_start returns a newly allocated parser object consumed by ansi_done. No per-line closure owns the global rendering context.
callback_targets.invariant: Direct helper calls must preserve active line and parser borrows.
limitations: This source-level target description does not replace native link verification.

invalidation.analysis: src/line.rs expand_linebuf frees both old arrays and republishes the replacements; prewind resets end, prefixes and ANSI scratch without moving every allocation. Saved end/column snapshots do not retain old content.
invalidation.invariant: Byte address lifetime and logical rendering validity must be tracked separately.
limitations: savec/loadc is not an ownership or generation mechanism.

mutation_commit.analysis: src/line.rs grows both arrays before replacement and frees partial candidates on allocation failure, but size_linebuf multiplication wraps and publication of buf/attr/size occurs in separate raw writes.
mutation_commit.invariant: Parallel arrays and capacity must describe one coherent completed render owner.
limitations: Successful staging alone does not prove every size calculation representable.

release_pair.analysis: src/line.rs frees replaced byte/attribute arrays and pairs ansi_done with the allocation from ansi_start. Retained global ANSI xbuffers and osc_ansi_allow have different process-scoped lifetimes.
release_pair.invariant: A parser-state free must not release global rendering storage.
limitations: No blanket exit-time destructor balance is claimed for retained global buffers.

error_cleanup.analysis: src/line.rs failed dual-array growth frees whichever candidate succeeded and keeps the old arrays; raw-line reading then stops with a partial bounded line, writes a NUL and publishes the resulting length.
error_cleanup.invariant: Failure must preserve usable old storage while exposing honest content bounds.
limitations: The return position alone is not a full lower-layer error classification.

signals_handoff.analysis: src/line.rs raw reading polls sigs, yet mutable globals and returned line pointers still rely on serialized rendering. M0-MEM-001 stays open; polling is not an owner-retirement protocol.
signals_handoff.invariant: A suspended render borrower must not observe incompatible global replacement.
limitations: No direct handler-to-line-buffer reallocation route is claimed here.
